name: Sasakura Sakura
source:
Born in 2008. First year at Parthenos.
A student playing oboe and belonging to the school concert band. The members decided that they wanted a first year to be included in the upcoming concert. She has a hard time satisfying that request and fell asleep while practicing on her own.
